description: This file contains functions for merging chat history messages, including deduplication based on timestamps, roles, and external IDs, as well as comparison and extraction utilities.

methods.name: extractComparableText
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes text from a message object for comparison.

methods.name: resolveFiniteNumber
methods.description: Checks if a value is a finite number and returns it.

methods.name: resolveComparableTimestamp
methods.description: Extracts timestamp from a message object.

methods.name: resolveComparableRole
methods.description: Extracts role string from a message object.

methods.name: resolveImportedExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves external ID from message's __openclaw metadata.

methods.name: isEquivalentImportedMessage
methods.description: Determines if two messages are equivalent based on external ID, role, text, and timestamp.

methods.name: compareHistoryMessages
methods.description: Comparator function for sorting messages by timestamp and order.

methods.name: mergeImportedChatHistoryMessages
methods.description: Merges local and imported chat messages, removing duplicates and sorting.
